notes.title: Huge Update Coming Less Than Two Years Away
notes.content: Within the next year to two years there will be a major updating coming. I don't want to give too much away, but the levels will more seamlessly flow together, there will be many more world, more enemies, a full story, complete redesign of artwork, new characters, new attacks and unlocks and much more. This will be released all at once and then the following updates will be smaller to fix bugs and provide smaller features. It will all be free to everyone who already bought the game. There won't be paid dlc for these new features.

tags.feature: - the levels will more seamlessly flow together, there will be many more world, more enemies, a full story, complete redesign of artwork, new characters, new attacks and unlocks and much more.

notes.title: Major Update Coming Soon
notes.content:
- No this game isn't dead!
- Major update coming soon that will massively improve gameplay and make the game fully unique to play. All the levels will still be in it and all the characters will be in it too. Story will remain the same. 
- Major update will be released on Steam and Android. 
- Android version will be free, but with ads. Steam version will stay around $4, but will never have ads. 
- I wish I could give a more exact date, but expect it to be within the next month. 
- I plan on taking the game out of early access after 2/3 of the story is complete. Most likely will be next year in 2024.

tags.feature: - Major update coming soon that will massively improve gameplay and make the game fully unique to play.
- Major update will be released on Steam and Android.
- Android version will be free, but with ads. Steam version will stay around $4, but will never have ads.

notes.title: Graphics Menu Fixed and Volume Saves Value
notes.content:
For our January update we have some more optimizations and just quality of settings fixed. More content will be added soon, more levels will be what I work on next.

In this update:
- Adjust AMD FSR level into 5 different modes. Off, Quality, Balanced, Performance and Ultra Performance.
- By default FSR is set to Quality. So, the game will run better for more users.
- Volume for music will now save even after closing the game. 
- Volume slider will also be positioned in correct spot for the current volume value. Even after exiting the menu.
- Graphics Menu is moved to a better spot in pause menu.
- Main Menu Graphics menu is updated to look the same as graphics menu in pause menu.

notes.title: Major Update Coming
notes.content:
The next update will have major additions to the game with new content. You can get new character unlocks and even more characters will be added later on.

You will be able to level up each individual character to unlock the next one or to just see how high of a level you can get to. 

I will also be trying to roll out some new levels and enemies in this update, but the main focus is new playable characters with level up systems.

notes.title: New Update Coming
notes.content:
I am proud to announce we will soon be having a new update. This update will add the following and add new things:

- Press the . key to buy axes with 2 coins instead of having to go into the shop menu every time to do it.
- At least world 2 Level 2, but most likely a few more levels too.
- New enemies for World 2.
- New in game purchasable items for the game shop (Won't cost real money).
- New artwork and level designs. 
and much more. Expect this update soon, but keep in mind I am a solo developer working on this project. 
Thank you all for your support.
